content: We need to search templates based on functional groups broken/formed? The tool expects bond types like "6-6". For sulfonamide formation, the forward reaction: aromatic amine attacks electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, S-Cl bond broken, N-S bond formed. Bond types: S-Cl is a single bond between sulfur (atomic number 16) and chlorine (17). In the format "6-6"? Actually they use atomic numbers? Example "6-6" is C-C, "6-8" is C-O. So S is atomic number 16, Cl is 17, N is 7. So bond broken: "16-17". Bond formed: "7-16". Let's try that.
